answer_1.quote: We propose a novel multi-level hierarchical and recurrent VAE structure called Variational Hierarchical Dialog Autoencoder (VHDA)... Our model enables modeling all aspects (speaker information, goals, dialog acts, utterances, and general dialog flow) of goal-oriented dialogs... The model generates synthetic dialogs and utterances for data augmentation.
answer_1.outputs: Synthetic dialog samples including speaker turns, goals, dialog acts, and utterances

answer_2.quote: we use ROUGE-L F1-score to evaluate the linguistic quality and utterance-level unigram cross-entropy (Serban et al., 2017) (regarding the training corpus distribution) to evaluate diversity.
